description: Uploads every message that reaches this node to an S3 bucket as its own object. Generates the object key from a prefix, a naming rule and an extension. Uses the aws_s3 library for signing and transport.

config.label: Region
config.description: The AWS region the bucket lives in. Must match the bucket, or S3 rejects the signature.

config.label: Bucket Name
config.description: The S3 bucket to upload into.

config.label: Access Key
config.description: AWS access key ID. Stored encrypted and decrypted only when the script reads it.

config.label: Secret Key
config.description: AWS secret access key. Stored encrypted and decrypted only when the script reads it.

config.label: Endpoint Override
config.description: Leave blank for AWS. Set to a full base URL to point at an S3-compatible service such as MinIO or LocalStack.

config.label: Key Prefix
config.description: Prepended to every generated object key. A trailing slash makes it behave like a folder.

config.label: Key Naming
config.description: How the unique part of the object key is generated. Timestamp + GUID sorts chronologically and never collides.

config.label: Key Extension
config.description: File extension appended to the generated key, without the dot. Leave blank for no extension.

config.label: Content Type
config.description: The Content-Type stored with the object, which is what a browser uses to decide whether to render or download it.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, requests are signed and logged but never sent. Lets you prove configuration and signing are correct before touching a real bucket.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Verify the server certificate. Leave on for AWS; turn off only for a local S3-compatible service with a self-signed certificate.
